verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents structured JSON extraction through the scrape endpoint using a `json` format that takes a natural-language prompt plus a schema (firecrawl-docs-16, firecrawl-gh-7). An AI agent mode retrieves data from a plain description of what is needed (firecrawl-gh-1), and 'extract' is listed as a job type (firecrawl-docs-11). Missing for 10: in-depth docs on prompt-only extraction without a schema, evidence on extraction accuracy or quality, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language extraction.
